description: This file defines a PowerpointLoader class that extends BufferLoader to load and parse PowerPoint documents using officeparser. It extracts slide content and metadata such as slide number and document type, splitting the content into individual slides based on common patterns.

classes.name: PowerpointLoader
classes.description: A class that loads PowerPoint files, parses their content into slides, and provides metadata for each slide.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Asynchronously parses raw PowerPoint data into an array of Document objects, extracting slide content and metadata.

methods.name: splitIntoSlides
methods.description: Splits the extracted text content into individual slides based on heuristic patterns.
